name: deepseek-harness
description: Inspect per-call Codex policy and explicitly authorized passive Desktop connection; task dispatch awaits native policy enforcement.

interface.shortDescription: Check caller scope and existing Desktop connection.
interface.longDescription: Connect passively to an explicitly authorized existing Desktop Host and inspect each caller’s requested directory scope. Task dispatch is blocked until Desktop can enforce the current Codex sandbox policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check Desktop attach readiness and inspect_access_scope for this agent’s requested read/write directories. Use host-supplied transport metadata as authority. Explain any missing DSH execution boundary and do not bypass it. Connect only with a file I explicitly approve.
